persistence_candidate: One Identity-owned set row per immutable set reference (the set reference is also its generation boundary), with owner, lifecycle version and current profile/classification references.

Individual code rows contain a native salted verifier, internal entry reference and one-way consumption/cause metadata. Lifecycle version changes for replacement/admission drift; individual usage does not silently redefine all other codes' bindings.

A recovery-code owner operation row binds exact request/Account/session/origin/change/context/expected resource-version/policy and safe result. Reuse existing identity owner-ledger/outbox patterns; do not build a general credential repository or proof-outcome ledger.

Do not store redeemable code strings, native RecoveryCodes tokens, reversible recovery escrow, URI/download bodies or verifier blobs in events/logs/evidence. Native hasher input is purpose/Account/set/format bound through unambiguous versioned serialization, not the generic user parameter.
generate_replace: Start/read resolves real User actor and current owner policy; current metadata read never generates. Stable duplicate identity returns the same safe owner operation.

Use the existing IUserStepUpOperationOutcomeSource/StepUpApplication owner callback. Lock current Account/session and recovery target in existing order; re-resolve approved policy, current source, expected versions, expiry and replacement plan.

Within the same local proof-consumption transaction, create native random values/verifiers under bounded work or validate a same-request prepared snapshot; persist complete distinct verifiers, approved old-set effects, safe owner result and outbox. No provider/network I/O in the callback.

Recheck all authority after native work and immediately before commit, including profile origin/scope/current operation and expected effective version. Owner failure rolls back code/set/proof/effects/outbox together; no falsely completed operation or discarded live verifier claim.

Only the winning request can retain a transient first-delivery value. Emit it after confirmed COMMIT via an explicitly reviewed BFF projection; discard it on rollback/UNKNOWN. Mark no-more-server-disclosure at the transaction boundary without pretending the user received or saved the response.

Duplicate, reload, back/forward, another tab or uncertain commit reconciles safe exact original status only; never regenerate or recover plaintext. A fresh replacement is a new current authorized owner operation if policy allows.

Use the existing HTTPS/same-origin/CSRF/strict-body security boundary and explicit no-store/no-referrer responses. No secret in URL/history/cookie escrow/telemetry; retained transient plaintext has no cross-request cache and no promise of complete managed-runtime memory zeroization.
consume: Consume is internal to the trusted Identity recovery owner, not a public code-validity endpoint. P2-011 supplies the current authorized recovery-operation/set context; no existing strong-factor session or automatic authentication is inferred.

Use bounded canonical input and native verifier mechanics with recovery-purpose/owner/set binding. If expensive verification happens outside locks, pin its verifier/set/policy snapshot, then re-lock and recheck the exact unchanged rows and current authority before a claim.

Reject absent, inactive or mismatched same-owner transaction/DbContext. Atomically mark one unused entry consumed with its exact cause and commit the dependent recovery-owner mutation/result/outbox in that transaction; losing concurrent attempts cannot consume again. Revalidate current recovery-case/policy/set bindings after awaited verification at the final commit boundary.

Same-operation duplicate recovery is a safe owner-result read; a consumed code never becomes another proof. Different-operation same-code contention, replacement races, policy/set drift and owner rollback must have one current linearization.
The returned claim is provisional until the owner commits. P2-009 does not mint a final session, upgrade assurance, replace all codes after use or apply full011 effects.

actual_browser_seam.observed: Existing CompleteBrowserAsync returns Task, followed by fixed ProofCompleted JSON; it cannot currently project a typed one-time set response.
actual_browser_seam.proposed_review: Root reviews a narrow recovery-owner first-delivery projection in the existing completion path, or an owner endpoint using the exact same internal proof transaction. Do not implement a generic secret transport, duplicate proof engine or module API change without that review.
rejected_shortcuts: Later GET generation or second disclosure
Deterministic regeneration from a retained master secret
Separate native token-store path or HTTP recovery-code oracle

download_boundary: Owner must first admit exact display/download semantics. Then a recovery-only private child may admit one exact owned download and privately verify bounded bytes/cleanup. Existing TOTP no-download boundary remains intact; requested is not proof of human custody or storage success.
test_design_handoff: Native format/canonical uniqueness and cross-owner/set/purpose rejection
Exact-proof issue/replace rollback, duplicates and UNKNOWN status
Public boundary canaries before any actual code, including intentional download cleanup
